bounds.domain: Three distinct volume and trash-id pairs, one visible selection, one confirmation and one in-flight storage operation.
bounds.assumptions: Each identity represents a distinct volume/id pair. Storage success or failure is observed once. The storage backend retains ownership, revision and transactional checks.
bounds.limitations: The model covers selection, refresh pruning, cancellation and captured effect targets. Native durability, permission changes during an operation and filesystem rollback remain covered by the storage implementation checks.
bounds.progress: A dispatched storage operation settles only under weak fairness of its finish step. Provider success is not assumed.

assumptions: Weak fairness of the finish step for dispatched restore/delete operations, allowing either success or failure.
